name: A yielded nil is a legitimate value and done terminates later

input.source_text: mut n = 0; mut seen = []; class It { public fun next() { n = n + 1; if n < 2 { Iteration.yield(nil) } else { Iteration.done } } public fun close() { nil } } class S { public fun iterator() { It.new() } } for v in S.new() { seen.append(v) } seen
